verdict.rationale: mise supports overriding tool backends (MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL>), disabling backends, custom registries via the http backend with per-platform URLs/checksums, and toggling registry floating behavior — giving platform engineers some control over source/mirror selection. However, there is no documented evidence of scoped authentication (tokens, credentials, per-registry auth) for private registries or mirrors. missing for 10: explicit auth/token configuration for private registries, documentation of mirror authentication, examples of enterprise/private registry setup with credentials.
